title: Enhancing Universal Access to Information in the 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda
summary: The United Nations emphasizes enhancing universal access to information as a key component of the 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda, ensuring inclusivity for all, including people with disabilities.
body:
The United Nations emphasizes enhancing universal access to information as a key component of the 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda, ensuring inclusivity for all, including people with disabilities.
